reviews.title: Low quality
reviews.text: Photos come out grainy and/or blurry. Scanning system is janky and produces a bad final image.

reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: This “scanner” just takes a photo of your photo. It’s not a scanner. The glare removal feature does not work and it wont export to the iPhone photo library. Glad it was free.

reviews.title: pretty bad
reviews.text: it asked me to scan the picture by moving the picture out of frame and then it doesn’t scan the picture it’s kind of broken

reviews.title: Ok for the novice
reviews.text: Initially when you use the app to take photos, you think, great. When you view the photos you realise that the results are missing detail and sharpness. I’d rather have a better result and pay for it than a poor result for free.

reviews.title: Inferior to Camera
reviews.text: I scanned about 20 photos for a memorial, and found the results to be disappointing - blurry and washed out. I switched to the default camera app on my iPhone 17 pro, and got clearer results with better color.

reviews.title: Is not able to detect photo size accurately.
reviews.text: Seems like it would work if it could accurately detect the photo boundaries!  I am photographing an old album (square) and have placed in on a black sheet with adequate lighting but the app is not able to sense where it is- so unfortunately it’s back to photoshop for us.  Please add the ability to manually set photo boundaries so this issue can be circumvented!

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Scanning feels buggy these days. The corners are almost always aligned in odd spots.

reviews.title: Please update this App!
reviews.text:
Stopped working after update to iOS 25.4. This has been the absolute best photo scan App I’ve used. Clearest  scans of documents & photos on my phone. 
Please can you (Google) get it working again.

reviews.title: Glare Removal doesn’t Work
reviews.text: Easy to use but the glare actually gets worse in the end result

reviews.title: Won’t scan to Google Photos
reviews.text: This app WILL NOT SCAN TO GOOGLE PHOTOS WITH AN iPhone. I learned this after hours of trial and error, research, and finally an in-depth conversation with ChatGPT.  It will save to Google Drive or other locations. I wanted to scan to a shared album in Google Photos but instead I had to put them in Google Drive and I’m currently researching how to efficiently batch upload them to a shared album, but that looks like more work than I expected too.

reviews.title: Crash!
reviews.text: Wonderful for the price of free but …. Needs an update. 3 years is a long time!

reviews.title: Impossible To Use
reviews.text: Good luck lining every thing up, the camera is set in mirror mode so it is dang near impossible to actually line up the photo in the square it provides THEN line up every dot. DO NOT BOTHER WITH THIS POINTLESS APP!!
